flags.title: OLBG hub time text uses inconsistent timezone conventions across sports
flags.detail: Read from OLBG hub pages (20:50-20:57Z) against official times: NHL/MLB/tennis/darts/golf text matches US Eastern (NHL '19:07' vs official 23:00Z = 19:00 ET nominal, +7 min pad; NBA text matches UK BST with a +10 min pad: OLBG '00:10' vs official 7:00 PM ET = 00:00 BST); rugby union text equals venue-local times exactly; EuroLeague text equals BST exactly. Official times (UTC) are authoritative on this desk; OLBG text is preserved verbatim under `olbg.time_text` only.

flags.title: OLBG Rathgormack v The Nire date conflicts with the official Munster GAA calendar
flags.detail: OLBG event 3536 shows '01 Nov 15:30'; the official Munster GAA calendar lists the 2026 Waterford Senior Football Championship Final Rathgormack v The Nire on Sun, Oct 25, 2026 @ 2:30pm at Cappoquin Logistics Fraher Field, Dungarvan. Official value published; OLBG text kept as discovery only.

flags.title: Direct fetch of the official PDC European Championship schedule page returns only a consent wall
flags.detail: Eight page-fetch attempts (news article, /tournaments, /live) returned cookie-consent content only on 2026-10-22 21:0x-21:1xZ. The same official page's content was read this session through indexed excerpts of that exact pdc.tv URL and was captured canonically at 07:17Z (data/current/evidence/pdc-extraction.json). Rows published with observed_by=pdc-same-day and this disclosure.

flags.title: OLBG tip counts are community votes, not probabilities or odds
flags.detail: OLBG '% Win Tips' figures (e.g. '16/20 Win Tips 80%') are stored under olbg.tips for transparency and never used as probabilities. OLBG event pages were not opened for bookmaker odds; no bookmaker quote is asserted anywhere on this desk (the only market quotes shown are the NHL API's officially embedded odds, labelled as such).

flags.title: Near-window and out-of-window model favourites are disclosed, not promoted
flags.detail: The brief's High gate (model p >= 0.70 AND fair price inside -250..+10000) excludes favourites whose fair price is shorter than -250 (p > 0.7143). Every such selection is listed in the >=70% out-of-window ledger on the Analysis page instead of being labelled High.

flags.title: WTA order-of-play times are tournament-local; UTC derived from the tournament's stated venue zone
flags.detail: Osaka (JST, UTC+9) and Ningbo (UTC+8) OP PDFs state venue and local times but not the zone abbreviation; UTC values are arithmetic from the stated venue location and flagged 'tz by venue'.
